metadata.question: Did Cincinnati, Ohio have its warmest February in 2018 (surface temperatures at 2 meters) compared to 2010 to 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use ERA5-Land or ERA5 for temperature data at 2 meters (temperature_2m) - Location: Cincinnati, Ohio (approximately 39.1°N, 84.5°W) - Compare February 2018 vs February 2010-2017 - Need to get mean temperature for each February 2. Masking strategy: - ERA5/ERA5-Land is reanalysis data, no cloud masking needed - Just filter by date and location 3. Logic: - Calculate mean temperature for February 2018 - Calculate mean temperatures for February 2010-2017 - Compare: if 2018 > all previous years, answer A; otherwise B - Handle cases where data is missing (C1), no valid pixels (C2), or calculation fails (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Cincinnati location const cincinnati = ee.Geometry.Point([-84.5, 39.1]); // Use ERA5-Land hourly data for 2m temperature const era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY'); // Function to get mean February temperature for a given year function getFebTemp(year) { const startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 2, 1); const endDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 3, 1); const col = era5 .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(cincinnati) .select('temperature_2m'); const size = col.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { return null; } const meanImg = col.mean(); const temp = meanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: cincinnati, scale: 11132, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('temperature_2m').getInfo(); // Convert from Kelvin to Celsius return temp !== null ? temp - 273.15 : null; } // Get February 2018 temperature const temp2018 = getFebTemp(2018); if (temp2018 === null) { console.log("No data for February 2018"); console.log("C1"); return; } console.log(`Feb 2018: ${temp2018.toFixed(2)}°C`); // Get temperatures for 2010-2017 const years = [2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017]; let warmest = -Infinity; let allValid = true; for (let year of years) { const temp = getFebTemp(year); if (temp === null) { console.log(`No data for February ${year}`); allValid = false; continue; } console.log(`Feb ${year}: ${temp.toFixed(2)}°C`); if (temp > warmest) { warmest = temp; } } if (!allValid) { console.log("C1"); return; } if (temp2018 === null || isNaN(temp2018) || warmest === -Infinity) { console.log("Calculation failed"); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`Warmest 2010-2017: ${warmest.toFixed(2)}°C`); if (temp2018 > warmest) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
